content: करटः [किरति मदं, कॄ-अटन् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 81.</ls>] .²1 An elephantʼs cheek; प्रभिन्नकरटौ मत्तौ भूत्वा कुञ्जररूपिणौ <ls>Mb. 1. 210. 20</ls>. .²2 Safflower. .²3 A crow; <ls>Śānti. 4. 19</ls>. .²4 An atheist, unbeliever. .²5 A degraded Brāhmaṇa. .²6 A man of a low profession. .²7 A musical instrument. .²8 The first Śrāddha ceremony performed in honour of a dead man; करट त्वं रट कस्तवापराधः <ls>Udb.</ls> .{@-टम@} Hard. (a variety of coral); <ls>Kau. A. 2. 11</ls>. .{@-टा@} .²1 An elephantʼs cheek. .²2 A cow difficult to be milked. .{@-मुखम्@} A spot where an elephantʼs temple bursts; <ls>Mb.</ls>
